scope.qa_public_page_title: 【人工智能挑战赛·常见问题参考】2026年第八届全国高校计算机能力挑战赛

explicit_pdf_requirements: non-medical public pretrained visual backbone weights with a license allowing competition use and redistribution; NC and gated rejected
only organizer medical training data for supervised fine-tuning
validation may be merged into training only after model/checkpoint/hyperparameter/threshold decisions are frozen
test data cannot participate in training, pseudolabels, fitting, checkpoint or parameter selection
fixed inference with declared precision, final submission predictions consistent with cost.py/predict.py
official T4 end-to-end batch1 timing on100 images after5 warmups, three repeats, mean <=100ms
inference-called weights and necessary configuration total<=500MB
source model name, public weight URL, full license, upstream dataset/model card, pretrained weight SHA256 and reproducible final submission materials
appendix A materials deadline is provincial/regional submission deadline
explicit_qa_reproducibility_notice: 根据大赛规则，区域赛/省赛阶段仅依据CSV文件的准确性进行排名。区域赛/省赛结束前，请所有参赛队伍选手提交训练模型，用于复现校验模型是否满足100ms的性能要求，并同步开展合规性与反作弊审查；如有必要，还需提交训练过程文档以复现结果。校验通过后确认晋级；若未达标，晋级名次将依次顺延。
stronger_user_supplied_requirements: fixed and recorded training seeds and reproducibility boundary
append-only per-epoch checkpoint timestamp and SHA256 ledger
archive exact source and dependency versions actually used
distinction: The stronger user-supplied items improve traceability and should be implemented under the user request; they were not found as separate explicit clauses in this PDF or the publicly returned QA tab. Absence in these retrieved sources does not prove no later organizer notice exists.
source_priority_note: Some earlier QA entries allow external unlabeled medical/self-supervised pretraining, which conflicts with the more specific dated2026-10-23 PDF. Apply the restrictive PDF requirements rather than relying on older permissive QA.
current_training_compliance_limit: This source audit alone does not certify current training or final deployment; final byte size, FP16 predictions, output coverage and official T4 timing remain to be tested after training.
